name: (04) Dark Thaumaturgy (Taking of the Spirit) — 2 Intermediate — Sap Will

system.description:
Now the infernalist strikes at the very heart of a victim's self, tearing away their strength of will, though a strong enough mind can turn the assault back upon its caster.

Issue a Mental Challenge, bidding three Mental Traits; on a win your victim loses a Willpower Trait. You may drain no more than three Willpower Traits per night from any given target. Unlike the lesser powers of this path, Sap Will is obvious to its victim as some sort of mystic attack, and it requires line of sight. Retest with Subterfuge.
